Areeiro — Lisbon, Portugal

🟡 Local press research

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Local and national press have repeatedly documented a rise in break-ins and vandalism in Areeiro, alongside what one parish official called drug trafficking that is "evident to everyone," concentrated around the Portugal Novo social-housing area; the same official summarised it as "peace by day, war by night." PSP has run special operations in the parish (jointly with Penha de Franca and Beato) seizing drugs, arms and munitions, and separately detained a man for drugs/arms found during a traffic stop in Areeiro. Daytime problems (opportunistic theft, vandalism, aggressive begging) are documented but described as markedly less severe than after dark. Sources checked: Publico, 13 Jan 2020 – "Moradores do Areeiro preocupados com vaga de assaltos e vandalismo"; Correio da Manhã / 24notícias – "Assaltos e vandalismo aumentam na freguesia do Areeiro em Lisboa"; Correio da Manhã – "PSP de Lisboa faz operação especial no Areeiro, Penha de Franca e Beato" (12 detidos, armas e droga apreendidas); Diário do Distrito – "PSP apreende droga, armas e munições a homem detido em fiscalização rodoviária no Areeiro"; Observador, special report (2024/2025 series) – "Insegurança em Lisboa ou mera perceção? Um raio-X aos pontos mais problemáticos da capital".
